_Description: Column description of the phenotype table of the initial release of the NKI-Rockland Sample (NKI-RS1) (sidecar of phenotype.csv, see studies/template/phenotype.json). The first row gives the study defaults of all sessions, add one row per participant or session below (e.g. of the phenotypic table of INDI).

participantID.Description: ID of the participant (key column, not exported), i.e. the participant label of the imported BIDS dataset (without sub-) or the DICOM PatientID.

scandate.Description: Date of the scan session (key column, not exported). Empty: all sessions of the participant.

participantGroup.Description: Analysis group of the participant, e.g. NC (no psychiatric diagnosis) or PSY (psychiatric diagnosis).

sex.Description: Sex of the participant (M or F).

handedness.Description: Handedness of the participant (R, L, or A).
